outcome: left ventricular modified myocardial performance index (LMPI)
cohort: 40 women with ICP and 40 healthy controls
finding: Fetuses of mothers with ICP had impaired global ventricular function as evidenced by increased LMPI, and higher LMPI was associated with adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found that the incidence of cesarean section was significantly higher in the group with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy.
